# apple_subscription_win_back_offers (Data Source)

Lists the win-back offers of a subscription.

Apple publishes no collection of win-back offers of its own, and an offer never reports which subscription it belongs to, so this is the only way to find one made in App Store Connect — for reading it, or for the `<subscription_id>/<offer_id>` ID that imports it into an `apple_subscription_win_back_offer`. Prices are not listed: they are a separate collection per offer, and the resource reads them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_apps" "example" {
  bundle_id = "com.example.app"
}

data "apple_subscription_groups" "premium" {
  app_id = data.apple_apps.example.apps[0].id
}

data "apple_subscriptions" "pro_monthly" {
  group_id           = data.apple_subscription_groups.premium.subscription_groups[0].id
  product_id_pattern = "^com\\.example\\.app\\.pro\\.monthly$"
}

# Every win-back offer on the plan, including ones made in App Store Connect.
data "apple_subscription_win_back_offers" "pro_monthly" {
  subscription_id = data.apple_subscriptions.pro_monthly.subscriptions[0].id
}

# One offer by its offer_id, for example to find the import ID of an offer made
# by hand: "<subscription_id>/<offer_id>".
data "apple_subscription_win_back_offers" "half_price" {
  subscription_id = data.apple_subscriptions.pro_monthly.subscriptions[0].id
  offer_id        = "pro_monthly_winback_2027"
}

output "win_back_offer_ids" {
  value = [for offer in data.apple_subscription_win_back_offers.pro_monthly.win_back_offers : offer.offer_id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `subscription_id` (String) The ID of the subscription whose win-back offers to list.

### Optional

- `offer_id` (String) Return only the offer with this `offer_id`, matched exactly.

### Read-Only

- `total_count` (Number) Number of win-back offers the subscription has, before `offer_id` narrows them.
- `win_back_offers` (Attributes List) The win-back offers, sorted by `offer_id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--win_back_offers))

<a id="nestedatt--win_back_offers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `win_back_offers`

Read-Only:

- `customer_eligibility_paid_subscription_duration_in_months` (Number) How long a customer must have paid before lapsing, in months.
- `customer_eligibility_time_since_last_subscribed_in_months` (Attributes) How long ago the customer must have lapsed, in months, inclusive. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--win_back_offers--customer_eligibility_time_since_last_subscribed_in_months))
- `customer_eligibility_wait_between_offers_in_months` (Number) How long a customer must wait before redeeming the offer again, in months; null for no wait.
- `duration` (String) The length of one offer period, such as `ONE_MONTH`.
- `end_date` (String) The last day the offer is available (`YYYY-MM-DD`); null for none.
- `id` (String) Apple's ID for the offer.
- `offer_id` (String) The identifier StoreKit transactions and reports carry.
- `offer_mode` (String) `PAY_AS_YOU_GO`, `PAY_UP_FRONT` or `FREE_TRIAL`.
- `period_count` (Number) How many periods the offer lasts.
- `priority` (String) `HIGH` or `NORMAL`.
- `promotion_intent` (String) `USE_AUTO_GENERATED_ASSETS` or `NOT_PROMOTED`.
- `reference_name` (String) The offer's name inside App Store Connect.
- `start_date` (String) The first day the offer is available (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
- `target_subscription_plan_type` (String) `MONTHLY` or `UPFRONT`, for a subscription sold both ways.

<a id="nestedatt--win_back_offers--customer_eligibility_time_since_last_subscribed_in_months"></a>
### Nested Schema for `win_back_offers.customer_eligibility_time_since_last_subscribed_in_months`

Read-Only:

- `maximum` (Number) The most months since lapsing.
- `minimum` (Number) The fewest months since lapsing.
